plainTranslation: Composite Mercury in the 12 House: With Composite Mercury in the 12th house, you can open up with one another about the things you may normally not talk about, which can create a strong bond between you. On the other hand, you can keep more secrets from each other and not feel like you can be open with each other. You may even volley between the two. You may also find that one of you divulges a tremendous amount, and the other helps to deal and understand, but doesn’t open up as much. There can be a great deal of subconscious understanding between you.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
